bundle.shortDescription: A Terminal with an Ollama Co-Pilot
bundle.longDescription: Termalime is a Tauri-powered desktop cockpit that fuses a full terminal emulator with an AI chat console. It is built for developers who constantly bounce between shell sessions and AI prompts—everything lives in a single split-pane workspace with a polished lime-dark aesthetic.
